name: Lenomila Shelf
releaseNotes: Keeps the shared store client aligned with NovaStore's legacy package compatibility guard. Modern clients ignore the old com.novastore.client bridge entry if it appears in the NovaStore catalog, avoiding duplicate or confusing store rows.
description: Lenomila Shelf is a companion private Android app catalog for the same signed app collection. It focuses on browsing, sharing, checking updates, viewing release details, and installing verified GitHub-hosted APKs through Android's normal installer flow.
